are_you_ok.title: Evacuations ordered for Penley Fire west of Sedalia
are_you_ok.summary: A fast-moving wildfire west of Sedalia forced evacuations on July 27 — the most direct threat to people the reader might be checking on this week, with families potentially displaced.
are_you_ok.description: A wildfire evacuation order was issued around 5 p.m. Sunday for people within a two-mile radius of West Douglas Fire Station 132.

are_you_ok.title: Friends rally for woman detained by ICE at Denver airport
are_you_ok.summary: A woman detained by ICE at Denver airport on July 24 drew friends rallying to her support; a personal-scale enforcement story that lands hard on anyone in immigrant communities the reader may know.
are_you_ok.description: A friend and former employer of a woman detained by federal agents at Denver International Airport has been advocating for her release from detention.

conversation_starters.title: Eastbound I-70 reopens east of Denver
conversation_starters.summary: Eastbound I-70 buckled and closed east of Denver before reopening July 27 — a widely-felt commuter disruption that's easy to bring up with anyone who drives the corridor.
conversation_starters.description: Eastbound I-70 east of Denver was closed for emergency repairs after road buckling, according to CSP.

conversation_starters.title: AC/DC in Colorado: What to know for the stadium concert
conversation_starters.summary: AC/DC brought a stadium concert to Colorado this week (plus Megan Moroney) — a marquee event and a natural, upbeat opener for a Monday 1:1.
conversation_starters.description: Arguably the world’s greatest rock and roll band, AC/DC is back in Colorado for the first time in 10 years, ready to rock Colorado's largest stadium on Tuesday.

conversation_starters.title: A Colorado reservoir is so low it revealed a lost ATV
conversation_starters.summary: Green Mountain Reservoir dropped so low it revealed an ATV lost for 5 years — first surfaced July 27 and still circulating July 28; a memorable drought curiosity that gets people talking.
conversation_starters.description: Low water levels at Colorado's Green Mountain Reservoir reveal a missing ATV after 5 years. The Summit County Sheriff's Office said drought exposes lost treasures.

conversation_starters.title: Aurora's Day of Resilience honors theater shooting victims while supporting long-term healing
conversation_starters.summary: Aurora's Day of Resilience on July 26 honored theater shooting victims and emphasized long-term healing — a meaningful community moment for the metro.
conversation_starters.description: Khloey Pace and Peyton Soltis are the young faces behind Veronica's Lemonade Stand at Aurora's Day of Resilience, where every cup served honors the memory of 6-year-old Veronica Moser-Sullivan, the youngest victim of the 2012 Aurora theater shooting.

you_should_know.title: 4th firefighter dies from burn injuries battling Colorado's Knowles wildfire
you_should_know.summary: A fourth firefighter died from burn injuries battling Colorado's Knowles wildfire, confirmed July 25 and again reported July 26 — the week's gravest wildfire toll, context to walk in aware of.
you_should_know.description: A fourth firefighter died from burn injuries battling Colorado's Knowles wildfire in the western part of the state at the end of June.

you_should_know.title: Denver Water asks customers to stick to watering restrictions, hopes residents "work even harder at conserving"
you_should_know.summary: Denver Water pressed customers to observe watering restrictions and conserve harder (July 24), reflecting the deepening drought squeezing the metro.
you_should_know.description: Denver Water says its customers are using less water than they were this time last year, but officials warn conservation efforts are still falling well short of what is needed as the drought persists​.

you_should_know.summary: The ACLU asked the Colorado Supreme Court to review the ruling upholding Boulder's camping ban (July 27) — a live housing and civil-liberties fight close to home.

you_should_know.title: Faith leaders and community members sue Colorado town of Hudson in effort to block planned ICE detention center

you_should_know.title: Public pushback greets CDOT's Colorado Boulevard bus rapid transit proposal; nearly 3/4 comments oppose BRT
you_should_know.summary: CDOT's Colorado Boulevard bus rapid transit proposal drew heavy public pushback (July 25), with nearly three-quarters of comments opposed — a contentious local transit decision.
you_should_know.description: Nearly three out of every four written comments submitted to the Colorado Department of Transportation during the early public review of its proposed Bus Rapid Transit project on Colorado Boulevard oppose the idea.
